//: Set-local type map of set rustc_codegen_llvm (lane codegen-sets-m7; types.sets.json `typemap_extra`): the field types of
`CString` / `SmallCStr` are `Uint8Array`, the type the `IntoDiagArg` impls of src/rustc_error_messages/diagnostic_impls.ts
(`CString_into_diag_arg`, `SmallCStr_into_diag_arg`) take; whether the NUL is kept is for the lane that ports `to_string_lossy`.
`c_uint` is `u32`, or `u16` on 16-bit targets (core ffi/primitives.rs): a `number` either way.
